item.title: Heron
item.description:
An ancient dragon. The truth-teller.

Beyond

He reveals the real history: the unicorns built the obelisk, the rainbows drain life, the dragons were broken and now sustain Nephimhr with their own essence and are bound there. “In that moment of release, we found we could act.” He survives and reclaims the mountains.

item.title: Rhodes
item.description:
A unicorn. Beautiful and terrible.

Beyond

The beauty is an illusion over a true rotting form. His weapon is paradise – temptation, never force; he holds that a soul coerced does not count. He deploys beasts as enforcers, lies to Eri about her mother, and cranks the drain to punish her. Issah kills him; the illusion collapses to rot.

item.title: The Drain
item.description:
Life pulled from the world through lenses, cast through the obelisk, and thrown back as rainbows.

Beyond

It is a dial. Boil the frog slowly, and crank it up to punish.

item.title: The Obelisk
item.description:
Obsidian. It stands on an outcrop near the summit, its tip exceeding the peak.

Beyond

It is a prism. The unicorns built it. Everything the lenses take passes through it and comes out as light.

item.title: The Turning
item.description:
The story everyone is taught: the rainbows are the gods’ gift of peace.

Beyond

It is propaganda. The rainbows are the visible exhaust of the drain.

item.title: The Vessel People
item.description: A people the unicorns directed against the dragons.
